validated.text: Exact ledger reconciliation passes every event and full replay
validated.why: worst |Σlines − ΔNAV|/NAV0 over 110 runs = 2.65e-11; the option and perp identities close by construction (attribution.json)

validated.text: Live and simulation adapters produce identical commands for identical event traces
validated.why: PR I kernel smoke (`kernel::tests`) drives the shared DeskKernel from the backtester; a recorded live trace replayed through both adapters does not exist yet

validated.text: The strategy cannot create written options
validated.why: the engine has no write path: positions enter the ledger only through an accepted RFQ the desk BUYS (engine::on_flow)

validated.text: Calls and puts both quote, reserve, hedge, resell, expire, and exercise correctly
All three put PTBs and their fallback order pass atomic failure tests
validated.why: exercise::tests::put_route_goldens_match_the_shared_fixture + engine::tests::put_sweep_routes_like_the_live_waterfall (vault_underlying → base_flash → quote_flash → capacity reject; failed PTB moves nothing)
